notes.title: Nephenthesys Update 1.01
notes.content:
We have recently released an update that addresses some known bugs and makes some balance adjustments.

Here are the changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the drone attacks don't hit enemies/bosses.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Red Flash drone attack destroys the power ups on the screen.
[*] Increased the damage of all drone attacks.
[*] Adjusted the Purple Needle special mechanic to be more prominent.
[*] Increased the time of the power ups on screen.
[*] Increased the time of the Yellow Wasp Shield.
[*] Visual FX improvements.
[/list]
